senses.gloss: board-partition, esp. a wall of the festive booth (סוּכָּה).
units: <cite ref="Sukkah 4a:14">Succ. 4ᵃ</cite> <he>ד׳ האמצעי</he> the middle of the three walls.
Ib. ד׳ עקומה the curved wall, a legal fiction by which a part of the ceiling may be considered as part of a curved wall.—

senses.gloss: (trnsf.) side of a vessel, oppos. to bottom, rim &c. Ohol. IX, 16 תחת דָּפְנָהּ under the belly of its side; Tosef. ib. X, 9 דּוֹפְנָהּ. Ib. VII, 10 side of a cave, opp. to שקוף &c.; a. fr.
the chest surrounding the lungs, ribs, also a single rib.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 48a:3">Ḥull. 48ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>ריאה הסמוכה לד׳</he> lungs adhering to the chest.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 49a:3">Snh. 49ᵃ</cite> <he>ד׳ חמישית</he> the fifth rib (counting from the lowest).

senses.gloss: the paries of the abdomen. יוצא ד׳ a fetus extracted by means of the cesarean section.
units: Nidd. V, 1; a. fr.—Metaph. תלה בד׳ to suspend from the wall, i.e. to leave a decision in suspense.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 4:1:7">Y. Kidd. IV, 65ᵇ</cite> bot.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 6:7:3">Y. Snh. VI, 23ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>בריפן</he> (corr. acc.).—Pl. <he>דּוֹפַנִּים</he>, constr. <cite ref="D00315"><he>דּוֹפַנֵּי</he></cite>; mostly <cite ref="D00970"><he>דְּפַנּוֹת</he></cite>.
Ḥull. 45ᵇ דופני ריאה the grooves between the lungs, דפנות ribs.
<cite ref="Chullin 45a">Ib. 45ᵃ</cite> <he>שתי ד׳</he> two sides of the chest.—
Tosef. Ohol. VI, 2 בצד דּוֹפְנִי וכ׳ ed. Zuck. on the wall-like side of the tent.
<cite ref="Tosefta Ohalot 6:2">Ib.</cite> <he>עם דופני של אוהל</he>, ed. Zuck., read (with R. S. to Ohol. V, 7) <he>רפנות</he> or (with ed.) <he>דּוֹפְנוֹ</he>.
